title: Verifying Autoware Controller Node by Combining Model Verification and Runtime Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2610.15418v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Formal modeling and verification of autonomous driving systems remain challenging due to the vast operational space and the complexity of the control logic. We propose a hybrid verification approach that combines formal model verification and runtime monitoring for the trajectory-following control node of Autoware, an open-source autonomous driving platform. We formalize the controller as a hybrid system in differential dynamic logic (dL), and introduce an abstract model that captures the essential control dynamics. We then prove safety and liveness properties of the model using the KeYmaera X proof assistant. Complementarily, we monitor the constraints that assure the compatibility between the model and the Autoware implementation across numerical simulation runs using the Autoware toolchain, quantifying to what extent the implementation's behavior is subsumed by the verified model. translated_title: 通过结合模型验证与运行时监控来验证Autoware控制器节点
translated_abstract: 由于运行空间庞大且控制逻辑复杂，自动驾驶系统的形式化建模与验证仍然充满挑战。我们提出了一种混合验证方法，将形式化模型验证与运行时监控相结合，应用于开源自动驾驶平台Autoware的轨迹跟随控制节点。我们将该控制器形式化为微分动态逻辑中的混合系统，并引入一个捕捉核心控制动力学的抽象模型，随后使用KeYmaera X证明助手证明了该模型的安全性和活性属性。作为补充，我们在基于Autoware工具链的数值仿真运行中监控确保模型与Autoware实现之间兼容性的约束条件，量化了实现行为在多大程度上被已验证模型所涵盖。实验结果证实了……
tldr: 本文提出一种将微分动态逻辑形式化模型验证与运行时监控相结合的混合验证方法，用于验证开源自动驾驶平台Autoware轨迹跟随控制节点的安全性与活性属性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid verification approach combining formal model verification in differential dynamic logic with runtime monitoring to verify the safety and liveness properties of the trajectory-following controller node of the open-source autonomous driving platform Autoware.
